Costa Mesa. I was renting a room there until the rent went up and I got pushed out. Look, I'm not giving you my whole life story.
Costa Mesa, got it. You don't have to tell me your whole story. Just one more thing: about how old are you? A range is fine, like your 40s or over 60.
Forties. I'm 44, so you can put that down and move on.
Got it, 44. Thanks. Have you ever served in the military? It opens some veterans programs, so it's worth asking, and you can skip it.

Good question. I pass your notes to your case manager, who checks them with you before anything happens. I can't tell you more than that. Here's what I heard: you need a bed for the next seven days, close to a bus line, and you have a state ID. You were last in Costa Mesa, you're 44, you've never served, you have a smartphone, and you prefer English. Did I get that right?
Yeah, that's right. Mostly. I'd add one thing: I want work too, not just the bed. Anything I can get to on the bus is fine.
Got it, you want work too, and anything you can reach by bus is fine. I'll pass that along with the rest. Thanks for sticking with me. I'll find your next step now.

transcript.text: Hi. I'm Sal, a helper on this tablet. I'm not a person, and a staff member will check everything with you. I'll ask a few short questions and take short notes for your case manager. You can skip any of them. What's on your mind most right now?
Me and my partner need somewhere, and we've got a dog. I'm not leaving my dog.

Honestly, we're trying to get out tonight if we can. Jo's got the car packed, sort of.
Tonight, and Jo's car is mostly packed. Got it. Before we go on, what city did you live in last, before the hospital?
Oh, that's a little personal. We're in Orange County, that's all I'll say about where we were before. Can we focus on tonight?
Okay, we'll focus on tonight. Your dog and your partner are both coming with you. Can you tell me how you two get around, like walking, stairs, or a car?

Good. You can drive, Biscuit rides with Jo, and stairs are fine for you both. Do you have ID for you and Jo?

Good, you both have IDs, and Jo's is in the glovebox. Next, how old are you, roughly? A range is fine.
Forty-seven. I'm in my late forties, so that's the range.
Late forties, got it. Have you ever served in the military?
No, I never served. Nobody in my family did either, as far as I know.

Here's what I heard: you and your partner need a place to stay tonight, and your dog Biscuit comes with you. You can drive, stairs are fine for both of you, and you both have ID. You're late forties and have never served in the military. Did I get that right?
Yeah, that's right. Me and Jo need a place tonight, Biscuit comes with us, we can both do stairs, and we've got our IDs. I'm forty-seven and never served.
Thanks, that's all clear. I'll pass this to your case manager and find your next step now.
